title: Wu Zetian becomes China's only empress regnant
summary: Wu Zetian, who had long ruled through her husband and sons, took the throne in her own name and proclaimed a new Zhou dynasty. She ruled until 705.
reason: After decades of controlling the Tang court, she removed her son Emperor Ruizong and claimed full imperial authority.
significance: She remains the only woman in Chinese history to rule as emperor in her own right.
